title: Big Match Uniform Value
body_html:
Big Match Uniform Value

The Big Match is a two-player zero-sum stochastic game with one nonabsorbing state and two absorbing outcomes. MFoGT records that it has uniform value $$ \frac12. $$

The minimizer can guarantee this by mixing equally at every stage. The maximizer's long-run guarantee is subtler and is the core content of the theorem.

References

  • [MFoGT, Chapter 8, Theorem 8.6.1] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory, references/MechDesign.pdf. Uniform value of Gillette's Big Match.
